outcome: prevalence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
cohort: 1,118 women who gave birth at Babcock University Teaching Hospital, Ilishan-Remo, Ogun State Nigeria, between June 1st 2012 and May 31st 2017.
finding: The prevalence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy was 4.9%, with pre-eclampsia/eclampsia being the most common type (75.5%), and preterm delivery being the most common complication (48.7%).
mod_finding: The majority of women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (73.3%) were delivered by cesarean section.
